title.narrative: Climate, Adaptation and Resilience (CLARE) Accountable Grant

description.narrative: CLARE is a portfolio of programmes to enable socially inclusive and sustainable action to build resilience and adapt to climate change and natural hazards. As part of this portfolio, an accountable grant was established with South South North to deliver the Adaptation Research Alliance and the Climate Mainstreaming facility (see sibliing)
